newsitem.title: USA: Luby's says to buy back up to one mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Luby's says to buy back up to one mln shrs.

text.p: Luby's Cafeterias Inc said Thursday it will buy up to one million shares of its common stock in open-market transactions from time to time through December 31, 1998.

The company said the purchases will be made when market and business conditions are favorable. It is not committed to buy all one million shares, which would represent about four percent of shares outstanding.
The company said it has bought about 5.3 million shares in open-market transactions through November 1996 under previous purchase programs.
The company said the shares would be placed in its treasury for use in connection with employee benefit plans and for general corporate purposes.
